subject: Hi Potion
text: Following the path left from the four-way intersection leads to a chest containing a Hi Potion.

evidence.quote:
You can take the current up to a four-way intersection if you like, but then follow the path
left to a chest which contains a HI POTION.

subject: Arrows
text: Going right from the intersection leads to a chest containing Arrows.

evidence.quote:
From the intersection, go right to
a chest which contains ARROWS.

subject: Power Potion
text: Continuing right and down while avoiding the current leads to a chest containing a Power Potion.

evidence.quote:
Continue to the right, avoiding the current, 
and down to a chest which contains a POWER POTION.

subject: Mystery Pin
text: Walking up and left from the intersection leads to a chest containing a Mystery Pin.

evidence.quote:
Go back to the intersection, walk up a little, then left, avoiding the current, 
to a chest which contains a MYSTERY PIN.

subject: Potion
text: Heading up from the Mystery Pin leads to a chest containing a Potion.

evidence.quote:
Then, head up to a chest which
contains a POTION.

subject: Ex Potion
text: Hugging the right wall to enter the current leads to chests containing an Ex Potion and Spell Potion.

evidence.quote:
Hug the wall to your right until you can
walk into a current that will take you to the last two chests which contain an
EX POTION and SPELL POTION.

subject: Spell Potion

evidence.quote:
Hug the wall to your right until you can
walk into a current that will take you to the last two chests which contain an
EX POTION and SPELL POTION.

evidence.quote:
Head along the current
to a chest which contains an EMPTY BOTTLE.

evidence.quote:
Go down, slightly left, down, slightly right,

text: Riding the current in the lower area and walking back around leads to a chest containing a Hi Potion.

evidence.quote:

text: Walking into the upper right current leads to a chest containing a Miracle.

evidence.quote:

evidence.quote:

evidence.quote:

evidence.quote:
Take the current above, but
then walk right and up, around the left side of the upper current to a chest

evidence.quote:

evidence.quote:
